jobs.title: Postdoc Position in Digital Planning Framework for Circular and Climate Resilient Urban Environments
jobs.description:
Challenge: Enable integrated planning for circular & climate resilient buildings.

Change: Develop digital multi-scale decision-support workflows.

Impact: Support construction and renovation planning.

Job Description

The Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment of Delft University of Technology is hiring a Postdoctoral researcher to work on a recently awarded Horizon Europe project, entitled AURORA (Shaping safe, sustainable, and human-centered places) under the supervision of Assistant Professors Simona Bianchi and Olga Ioannou, and Associate Professor Maria Pregnolato.

The broader AURORA project aims at accelerating the transformation of the built environment towards climate resilience and circularity. The project has a strong social perspective aiming at both technological and governance innovation. It combines innovative construction technologies, digital workflows, multi-level governance approaches, and participatory processes to support the development and implementation of resilient renovation strategies. Through demonstration pilots across Europe, AURORA provides practical frameworks for municipalities, practitioners, and stakeholders to evaluate and implement sustainable construction and renovation pathways.

You will contribute to the development of AURORA resilient and circular strategies multi-scale assessment framework. You will do so by assessing and classifying existing products, product systems and building configurations in accordance with the AURORA assessment framework and the project’s demonstrator contexts. You will also establish data structures that enable the exchange and integration of this information within those contexts. You will ultimately develop a user-friendly, intuitive digital interface to enable decision-making of circular and resilient building pathways for built environment stakeholders (governance bodies, construction companies, and individual users). The developed digital workflows will be tested, and validated through pilot applications, ensuring applicability across different building typologies, spatial scales and data availability conditions.

Key Activities Include

Assessing integrated construction and renovation strategies, covering structural systems, façades and building equipment across different building typologies, climatic conditions and hazard contexts.
Translating assessed technologies and pathways into decision-ready parametric datasets and a structured database, enabling direct integration into AURORA digital planning workflows.
Developing a user-friendly, intuitive, digital interface to enable decision-making between built environment stakeholders.

As a Postdoctoral researcher, you will collaborate with two research groups within the Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment: Structures and Materials (restructgroup) and Building Design & Technology (architectural-facades-products), and one group within the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Geosciences: Hydraulic Structures and Flood Risk (hydraulic-structures-and-flood-risk). The position is funded for 18 months, during which the candidate will conduct postdoctoral research while contributing to the broader AURORA research program. The project offers opportunities to collaborate with leading European universities, industry partners, municipalities and public authorities working on circular construction, digital workflows and resilient urban development.

Job requirements

You have a PhD degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Technology, or a related field;
You have demonstrated experience working in one or more of the following areas: resilience planning, decision support systems, building technology, sustainability assessments;
Demonstrated knowledge of building and/or geographic information systems, data structures or software integration is a must;
You have excellent oral and written communication skills in English;
You are able to work independently and as part of a team, and to build collaborative, interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary networks;
You are motivated to develop digital solutions supporting sustainable and climate-resilient built environments;
Work experience in multi-institutional projects is not essential but will be considered an asset.   

TU Delft (Delft University of Technology)

Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference.

For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow.

These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future.

At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional.

Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward.

Faculty Architecture & the Built Environment

The Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment has a leading role in education and research worldwide. The driving force behind the faculty’s success is its robust research profile combined with the energy and creativity of its student body and academic community. It is buzzing with energy, with four thousand people enthusiastically studying, working, designing, conducting research and acquiring and disseminating knowledge. Our faculty has a strong focus on 'design-oriented research’, which has given it a top position in world rankings.

Staff and students are working to improve the built environment with the help of a broad set of disciplines, including architectural design, urban planning, building technology, social sciences, process management, and geo-information science. The faculty works closely with other faculties, universities, private parties, and the public sector, and has an extensive network in the Netherlands as well as internationally.

new_jobs.title: Postdoc Position in Digital Planning Framework for Circular and Climate Resilient Urban Environments
new_jobs.description:
Challenge: Enable integrated planning for circular & climate resilient buildings.

Change: Develop digital multi-scale decision-support workflows.

Impact: Support construction and renovation planning.

Job Description

The Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment of Delft University of Technology is hiring a Postdoctoral researcher to work on a recently awarded Horizon Europe project, entitled AURORA (Shaping safe, sustainable, and human-centered places) under the supervision of Assistant Professors Simona Bianchi and Olga Ioannou, and Associate Professor Maria Pregnolato.

The broader AURORA project aims at accelerating the transformation of the built environment towards climate resilience and circularity. The project has a strong social perspective aiming at both technological and governance innovation. It combines innovative construction technologies, digital workflows, multi-level governance approaches, and participatory processes to support the development and implementation of resilient renovation strategies. Through demonstration pilots across Europe, AURORA provides practical frameworks for municipalities, practitioners, and stakeholders to evaluate and implement sustainable construction and renovation pathways.

You will contribute to the development of AURORA resilient and circular strategies multi-scale assessment framework. You will do so by assessing and classifying existing products, product systems and building configurations in accordance with the AURORA assessment framework and the project’s demonstrator contexts. You will also establish data structures that enable the exchange and integration of this information within those contexts. You will ultimately develop a user-friendly, intuitive digital interface to enable decision-making of circular and resilient building pathways for built environment stakeholders (governance bodies, construction companies, and individual users). The developed digital workflows will be tested, and validated through pilot applications, ensuring applicability across different building typologies, spatial scales and data availability conditions.

Key Activities Include

Assessing integrated construction and renovation strategies, covering structural systems, façades and building equipment across different building typologies, climatic conditions and hazard contexts.
Translating assessed technologies and pathways into decision-ready parametric datasets and a structured database, enabling direct integration into AURORA digital planning workflows.
Developing a user-friendly, intuitive, digital interface to enable decision-making between built environment stakeholders.

As a Postdoctoral researcher, you will collaborate with two research groups within the Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment: Structures and Materials (restructgroup) and Building Design & Technology (architectural-facades-products), and one group within the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Geosciences: Hydraulic Structures and Flood Risk (hydraulic-structures-and-flood-risk). The position is funded for 18 months, during which the candidate will conduct postdoctoral research while contributing to the broader AURORA research program. The project offers opportunities to collaborate with leading European universities, industry partners, municipalities and public authorities working on circular construction, digital workflows and resilient urban development.

Job requirements

You have a PhD degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Technology, or a related field;
You have demonstrated experience working in one or more of the following areas: resilience planning, decision support systems, building technology, sustainability assessments;
Demonstrated knowledge of building and/or geographic information systems, data structures or software integration is a must;
You have excellent oral and written communication skills in English;
You are able to work independently and as part of a team, and to build collaborative, interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary networks;
You are motivated to develop digital solutions supporting sustainable and climate-resilient built environments;
Work experience in multi-institutional projects is not essential but will be considered an asset.   

TU Delft (Delft University of Technology)

Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference.

For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow.

These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future.

At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional.

Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward.

Faculty Architecture & the Built Environment

The Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment has a leading role in education and research worldwide. The driving force behind the faculty’s success is its robust research profile combined with the energy and creativity of its student body and academic community. It is buzzing with energy, with four thousand people enthusiastically studying, working, designing, conducting research and acquiring and disseminating knowledge. Our faculty has a strong focus on 'design-oriented research’, which has given it a top position in world rankings.

Staff and students are working to improve the built environment with the help of a broad set of disciplines, including architectural design, urban planning, building technology, social sciences, process management, and geo-information science. The faculty works closely with other faculties, universities, private parties, and the public sector, and has an extensive network in the Netherlands as well as internationally.

Job Position Summary

We are looking for a Compliance Analyst within our compliance consulting team. This individual will work within our Consulting Team helping clients to assess and implement renewable energy and low carbon projects. Our clients depend on revenue streams from the sale of emissions reductions credits – the majority of which are RINs under the federal Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) or credits under California’s Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS). However, as new emissions reductions commitments are made and new low carbon fuel policies are enacted, the related compliance burden for regulated parties becomes exponentially greater. Examples of new and emerging regulations/commitments include Oregon’s Clean Fuels Program (CFP), Washington’s Clean Fuels Program, Canada’s national LCFS, the airline industry’s CORSIA program, and various ESG reporting and data management needs.

Specific Job Responsibilities:

• Assist with delivery of projects within EcoEngineers Compliance Team. These projects may include technical, economic, and regulatory feasibility and analysis for: Renewable natural gas (RNG) projects such as landfill gas, wastewater treatment plant biogas, dairy/swine manure biogas, or food waste biogas; Renewable diesel; Renewable electricity; Renewable hydrogen; Carbon capture utilization and sequestration (CCUS)
• Assist with delivery of Ongoing Compliance Program supporting producers with the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) and/or the California Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS).
• Research and learn the following clean fuels regulations areas:
Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), California Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), Oregon Clean Fuels Program (CFP), Washington Clean Fuels Program, Other national, state, local, or voluntary regulations, as applicable
• Assist with project management of EcoEngineers consulting projects, which may include coordination and collaboration between multiple service lines.
• Assist with communication on scientific or technical information to internal and external clients through oral briefings, written documents, visual and verbal presentations, workshops, conferences, training sessions, or public hearings.
• Support other services lines within EcoEngineers Consulting Team including Training and Education, Regulatory Engagement, and Lifecycle Assessment teams.
Job Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher with an engineering, environmental, policy, or finance focused.
• Strong written, verbal and presentation communication skills are essential.
• Interest in renewable energy, biofuels, and lower carbon products to help the world decarbonize and combat climate change.
• Strong computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and etc.). Aptitude for learning new applications if needed.
• High degree of personal responsibility, timeliness, and organization, high competency with problem solving analytical and quantitative skills.
• Ability to work effectively on client deliverables with demanding deadlines in a team environment.
Preferences:

• 4+ years of professional experience
• Strong analytical skills around complicated topics
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

This partnership drives user success, increases retention and expansion, and supports mutually beneficial renewal outcomes. Few roles provide such a direct impact on the growth of the company.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a motivated and curious professional to manage a book of Platform customers. The CSM will deliver proactive workshops, business reviews, payments insights, and thought leadership to help users grow their business.

The ideal candidate is analytical and meticulous, and enjoys engaging customers to investigate issues and deliver insights. This role involves working closely with sales, technical account managers, and operations teams to engage customers in product, payment, and technical conversations.

Responsibilities

Partner closely with account executives and technical account managers to support post-sale engagements focused on the optimization, retention, and growth of Stripe’s platform customers
Manage a book of customers to drive overall account health including performance, product adoption, usage velocity, account renewals and growth, referrals, and customer satisfaction
Serve as a trusted payments and product advisor to managed customers by delivering payment performance and industry insights
Perform business reviews to align on user priorities, review payments performance metrics, share Stripe product roadmap and provide guidance on how to optimize the value from Stripe
Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share customer feedback and insights to Product Management, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Sales on the innovation and improvement needed to optimize the Stripe user experience
In coordination with an account team, support book expansion--identifying and surfacing opportunities to ensure customers are successful.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

10+ years of experience in a client-facing role in Enterprise relationship management, partnering with large, global, and complex organizations, preferably working with a technical product
Marketplace and/or SaaS Platform experience
3+ years of experience with consumption-based SaaS products (not license/seat)
Strong business sense and understanding of underlying drivers and strategy of our user’s businesses
Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions
Strong analytical skills

Preferred Requirements

Deep expertise in FinTech
Experience in embedded payments

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role. This role aligns with how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance, and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

Role

Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target complex, multi-threaded sales engagements involving senior executive stakeholders, technical buyers, and procurement teams.

Demonstrating trusted presence and strong communication skills to align customer decision-making through impactful technical engagements, tailored solution briefings, use-case-driven demonstrations, and workshops that translate complex security concepts into clear operational value.
Maintaining broad knowledge of the competitive landscape while validating the value of the Palo Alto Networks platform, clearly differentiating its solutions and aligning customer strategy through situational objection handling and technical advocacy.
Learning continuously to develop technical and professional expertise that drives greater customer impact, while actively contributing to the Solutions Consultant community through knowledge sharing and participation in internal and industry events.

Qualifications

Your Experience

6+ years technical pre-sales experience required; demonstrated success selling, implementing, or managing SaaS offerings strongly preferred.
Consistent history of meeting or exceeding sales targets, with a track record of executing seven-figure opportunities involving extended sales cycles, multiple buying centers, and multi-product solutions.
Proven ability to influence and gain buy-in from key stakeholders in customer-facing engagements.
Experience independently creating and delivering customized technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements across varied environments for strategic customer accounts.
Pre-Sales experience into large, complex enterprises, typically with multi-billion-dollar revenue and global or multi-regional operations, with a proven ability to manage a targeted number of high-value accounts (typically 10–30).
Demonstrated technical expertise or experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following: Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint, SASE, or AI Security.
Experience partnering with customer success or support functions to ensure successful implementation and drive solution adoption is strongly preferred.
Prior experience in architecting and positioning cybersecurity solutions that address technical challenges and support new business initiatives is strongly preferred.
Driven by technical curiosity to self-develop skills in emerging domains, utilizing high AI fluency to elevate work quality and accelerate outcomes.
